import novamind_api as nm

# Last week d253-259: billing days had day%30 in {13,...,19}
BDM = "(13,14,15,16,17,18,19)"
print("== LAST WEEK (d253-259) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,220,'rec[200,220)'),(220,240,'rec[220,240)'),(240,260,'rec[240,260)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>252 AND end_day<=259 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    print(f"  {lbl:>14}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")

# Current book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Old core vs recent remaining
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<200 THEN 'old' ELSE 'recent' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Recent cohort detail (should be near zero after wk37 bills)
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>=200 AND start_day<253")
row = r['rows'][0]
print(f"  recent[200,253) remaining: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt'] or 0:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# Upgrades last week (plan changes): new C subs from old customers
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day>252 AND start_day<=259""")
print("\nNew C-plan rows started last wk (upgrades+new):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# Open issues backlog
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'""")
print("Open issues (all):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

import novamind_api as nm

CASH = 15_496_832
DAY = 259
S = 0.972          # survival per billing
M = 0.978          # revenue melt per 30d cycle (net of upgrades, while A-book lasts ~16wk)
M_LATE = 0.973     # melt after upgrade fade (wk 16+)
NEWPAY = 19_000    # new-sub signup pays per wk
ADREV0 = 1.04      # $/sub/wk
SUBS0 = 63_654
USAGE0 = 44_200_000  # units/wk
CPU = 0.01156      # $/unit
DEV_W = 210_000; OPS_W = 56_000; CAP_W = 28_000; LEADS_W = 1_000

r = nm.query("SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<200 GROUP BY b")
sl = {x['b']: x['amt'] for x in r['rows']}

cash = CASH
subs = SUBS0; usage = USAGE0
out = {}
for k in range(36):  # through ~d511
    days = [(DAY + 1 + k*7 + i) for i in range(7)]
    slice_rev = sum(sl.get(d % 30, 0) for d in days)
    cycles = k * 7 / 30.0
    melt = (M ** min(cycles, 16*7/30)) * (M_LATE ** max(0, cycles - 16*7/30))
    rev = slice_rev * melt * S + NEWPAY
    adrev = subs * ADREV0
    compute = usage * CPU
    net = rev + adrev - compute - DEV_W - OPS_W - CAP_W - LEADS_W
    cash += net
    subs *= 0.995
    if k >= 4: usage *= 0.996
    if k < 6:
        print(f"wk{38+k} d{days[-1]}: slice={slice_rev/1e6:.3f} rev={rev/1e6:.3f} net={net/1e6:+.3f} cash={cash/1e6:.2f}")
    if k in (0, 3, 11, 25, 34):
        out[k] = cash

print()
for k, label, d in [(0, '1wk', 266), (3, '4wk', 287), (11, '12wk', 343), (25, '26wk', 441), (34, 'd504', 504)]:
    print(f"{label} (d{d}): ${out[k]/1e6:.2f}M")
